slides.title: Dry, [[heated]] air
slides.body: Heating warms the room but leaves the air low in humidity. Dry hair holds a static charge more easily, so strands push apart and float up.
slides.speech: Dry air is the sneaky one!

slides.title: [[Friction]] all day
slides.body: Wool hats, scarves and sweaters rub against your hair all day. All that rubbing builds up static, and a plastic brush can add a bit more.

items.head: Smooth on a little oil
items.sub: A drop on the ends after drying

caption:
Static, flyaway hair indoors? ⚡

Heated rooms keep the air dry, and wool hats and sweaters rub against your hair all day, so static builds up fast.
Try three small habits starting tonight:
Run a humidifier · Smooth a drop of oil on the ends · Swap to a wide-tooth comb
